about.heading: About us
about.subhead: A five-person comedy production company in Olympia, Washington, working across the South Sound.
about.story:
Stoned Goose Productions started in January 2025. We produce live stand-up across Olympia, Lacey, Tacoma, and the wider South Sound: booking the lineup, running the room, and handling the parts of a show an audience is never supposed to notice.

We also work on camera and behind a microphone, producing video and podcasts for comics and for the people who hire us. And we run our own room, the Log Cabin Comedy Open Mic, every Monday in Olympia.
about.oneLine: There are five of us. We produce the shows, shoot the video, cut the audio, and answer the email.
